# NxTools Windows patch on gpui-pre-windows 0.3.12

The published gpui-pre-windows 0.3.12 archive has SHA256 `7201762420222d5b5ce5bdf0056996199212a3349bfb2457a3a0238c688681f3`. `LICENSE-APACHE` is retained. `NXTOOLS-UPSTREAM.json` inventories the original published files. The matching core is gpui-pre 0.3.12; GPUI Fast is disabled.

The approved delta is limited to these files:

- `src/directx_renderer.rs`: includes the existing project GPU regressions under `cfg(test)`. The released ordinary and path-sprite blend states already use `INV_SRC_ALPHA` for destination alpha; there is no production blend-state delta.
- `src/events.rs`: refreshes restored margins at real `WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED` before default move/size callbacks. Custom normal and fullscreen frames use the full client area, maximized custom frames retain native sizing insets, and native captions retain default handling. Custom resizable frames handle all eight edges and corners. Maximized DPI transitions read the actual final client size. `WM_MOUSEACTIVATE` continues to read live `WS_EX_NOACTIVATE` set by the C# Windows adapter, returning `MA_NOACTIVATE` when set and `MA_ACTIVATE` otherwise. `WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING` carrying `SWP_SHOWWINDOW` for a hidden window whose background is not `Opaque` cloaks it (`DWMWA_CLOAK`, which only the owning process may set; `SetWindowPlacement`/`SW_SHOWNORMAL` shows send no `WM_SHOWWINDOW`) and a 34 ms window timer reveals it after its first frame; a failed timer reveals it at once.
- `src/shaders.hlsl`: `UnderBorder = 2` compensates background coverage for the later unchanged solid border without changing foreground, masks, child order or the SDF footprint.
- `src/window.rs`: measures all four restored nonclient margins with `ClientToScreen` and uses inverse client/window bounds conversions for placement. Before the first GPUI layout, the logical viewport/origin and renderer target use the actual created client instead of hidden `CW_USEDEFAULT` sentinels. Ordinary custom-caption windows expose requested Client decorations to the official WindowBorder; maximized/fullscreen edges are tiled, while native-caption/Server-requested/tool windows retain their existing shells. Maximized, minimized and fullscreen geometry cannot overwrite the restored margin cache. Window styles and target-display placement are unchanged. The owned-HWND regressions are included under `cfg(test)`.

Source and provenance gate: `python tests/architecture/gpui-release-contracts.py`. The filtered Windows regressions are `source_over_tests` and `gpui_window_frame`; use the repository's low-memory Rust settings. The regressions do not certify desktop Acrylic pixels, physical resizing or snapping, or mixed-DPI behavior.
